title: Degradation-Aware Optimal Sizing Framework for Grid-Interactive EV Charging Stations with PV, BESS, and Supercapacitor: Real Dataset Validation Using NASA PCoE, ACN-Data, and CHARGED -- Simulation Results and Validation Data
description: This dataset contains all numerical results, statistical validation data, sensitivity analysis outputs, and publication figures supporting the paper submitted to Modern Power Systems and Clean Energy (MPCE), IEEE/SGEPRI, IF 6.3, Q1. The repository includes: (i) optimal sizing results for all four case studies and four algorithms (GWO, BBO, AO, ARO); (ii) 30-run statistical validation results with Friedman rank test, Nemenyi post-hoc analysis, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; (iii) sensitivity analysis for the commercial degradation parameter alpha_comm and the sub-hourly peak factor kp; (iv) convergence quality metrics (AUC and speed); and (v) all publication figures. Raw datasets (NASA PCoE, ACN-Data, PVGIS-ERA5, CHARGED) are not included due to individual licensing but are publicly available at the sources cited in the paper. Simulation pipeline scripts are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
